data.title: D-ID
data.content: Talking avatar generation built on ChatGPT. D-ID offer an API and a brief 'pledge for the ethical use of synthetic media'.

data.title: HeyGen
data.content: Generates custom video content with talking avatars used to deliver text transcripts. Its code is not availble, though it has an API. Its offering limits creative maleability with 100 avatar presets.

data.title: Lalal
data.content: Audio Stem Splitter Lalal is a free online AI tool that removes vocals, separates music, and also does precise stem extraction. With the help of this tool, you can remove drums, bass, piano, instrumental, and acoustic guitar, and synthesize the tracks without the loss of the original quality. Though it is a proprietary tool with a clear and specific function, it has specific workflow benefit for musicians looking for clean stems to sample, and could perhaps be used for other more experimental audio functions too.

data.title: JADBio — AutoML
data.content: A knowledge extraction tool built purposely for multi-omics and biotech, you can still upload any sort of curated data and analyze it. The tool also helps people to build a predictive model. This could be repurposed from a broad base of artistic research projects with engage in data analysis; although it is widely interoperable in onward workflows, the processes themselves are somewhat opaque. There appears to be little available research to scaffold its use. Nonetheless it could be an interesting tool for artists to explore using extant datasets.

data.title: GFP-GAN
data.content: Photo Restoration Tool GFP-GAN or Generative Facial Prior-Generative Adversarial Network is a free AI tool that restores faces in old photographs developed by Tencent researchers using StyleGAN2. The tool is available open source, with good accompanying resources.
